Describe one column block of a bar table

Source: R/bar_table.R
bar_measure.Rd

Describe one column block of a bar table

bar_measure(
  value,
  n = NULL,
  label = value,
  n_label = "N",
  scale = 100,
  digits = 1,
  bar = TRUE,
  max = 100,
  suppress = TRUE,
  weighted_n = FALSE
)

Arguments

value

Column holding the outcome (a proportion in 0–1 unless scale = 1).

n

Column holding the sample size shown beside the outcome, or NULL.

label

Header text for the outcome column; \n breaks lines.

n_label

Header text for the sample-size column.

scale

Multiplier applied before display (100 turns a proportion into a percentage).

digits

Decimal places.

bar

Shade the cell in proportion to value / max.

max

Value that fills the cell completely.

suppress

Replace the outcome with (*) when n is below the table's suppression threshold.

weighted_n

Is n a weighted count (rounded for display)?

Value

A list of class vcs_measure.

Examples

bar_measure("estimate", "denominator", label = "PENTA1-PENTA3\nDropout (%)")
#> $value
#> [1] "estimate"
#> 
#> $n
#> [1] "denominator"
#> 
#> $label
#> [1] "PENTA1-PENTA3\nDropout (%)"
#> 
#> $n_label
#> [1] "N"
#> 
#> $scale
#> [1] 100
#> 
#> $digits
#> [1] 1
#> 
#> $bar
#> [1] TRUE
#> 
#> $max
#> [1] 100
#> 
#> $suppress
#> [1] TRUE
#> 
#> $weighted_n
#> [1] FALSE
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "vcs_measure"
